entry.title: Structure-coefficient theorem for evolutionary games on dynamic networks
entry.summary:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 22 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01068-9 The authors establish a structure-coefficient theorem, showing that three universal coefficients capture evolutionary outcomes in changing networks, and identify dynamic core–periphery networks that promote cooperation, altruism, fairness and trust.

Source: Nature Computational Science · Tags: #bioinformatics #materials-science #rust #logic

entry.title: FairFRESH: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Fair and Explainable Household Food Recommendation
entry.summary:
Recommender systems typically serve one user at a time. However, in households, members share a finite pantry and follow different dietary rules, making independent recommendations prone to resource conflicts and dietary violations. We formulate household food recommendation as constrained fair division and present FairFRESH, a neuro-symbolic framework that learns per-member utilities, allocates foods under explicit welfare objectives, enforces dietary rules through a deterministic filter, and explains recommendations using Shapley and Banzhaf attributions.

Source: arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) · Tags: #decision-theory #complex-systems #ml-theory #logic
